lines.cyr: - Дремка ми се дреме мила мамо,
lines.lat: - Dremka mi se dreme mila mamo,
lines.en: - I am sleepy, mother dear
my black eyes are tired.

lines.cyr: Ај, дремка ми се дреме мила мамо,
lines.lat: Aj, dremka mi se dreme mila mamo,
lines.en: - I am sleepy, mother dear
my black eyes are tired.

lines.cyr: - Ако ти се дреме мили сине,
lines.lat: - Ako ti se dreme mili sine,
lines.en: - If you are sleepy, dear son,
have a dinner and go to bed.

lines.cyr: Ај, ако ти се дреме мили сине,
lines.lat: Aj, ako ti se dreme mili sine,
lines.en: - If you are sleepy, dear son,
have a dinner and go to bed.

lines.cyr: - Ајде и да легнам мила мамо,
lines.lat: - Ajde i da legnam mila mamo,
lines.en: - Oh, even if I lie down, my dear mother,
dreams don't catch me.

lines.cyr: Ај, сон не ме фаќа мила мамо,
lines.lat: Aj, son ne me faḱa mila mamo,
lines.en: Oh, dreams don't catch me, my dear mother,
for my neighbor.
Go and ask for her hand, mother,
see if they give her to you.

lines.cyr: Ај, иди ја посакај мила мамо,
lines.lat: Aj, idi ja posakaj mila mamo,
lines.en: Go and ask for her hand, mother,
see if they give her to you.

lines.cyr: Ако ти ја дадат мила мамо,
lines.lat: Ako ti ja dadat mila mamo,
lines.en: If they give her to you, dear mother,
bring her over on a carriage.

lines.cyr: Ај, ако не ја дадат мила мамо,
lines.lat: Aj, ako ne ja dadat mila mamo,
lines.en: Oh, if they don't give her to you, dear mother,
stay for a while, look at her.
